## Rare surprises, a background you can lock in, and a flasher that tells you what you're about to get

CLEAR's idle screen now has a handful of rare, background-independent surprises that show up no matter which of the 10 background styles you're running -- a UFO drifting past, a burst of stardust sparkles, a bird or bat silhouette winging across, and an occasional glitchy one-liner flashing up like a corrupted transmission. Squachy gets his own version too: every so often he'll break the fourth wall, wink at you, and drop a line. All of it is purely decorative, on a long randomized timer (roughly every 1-3 minutes) so it stays a surprise instead of a distraction.

Also new: a LOCK BACKGROUND setting for anyone who's landed on a favorite and doesn't want an accidental tap changing it. It disables the CLEAR-screen tap-to-cycle gestures specifically -- the Settings menu's own BACKGROUND row still works normally, so picking something new is always a deliberate trip to Settings rather than an accident during normal use.

The web flasher now shows the latest firmware version right up top, pulled live from the deployed manifest, so it's obvious at a glance whether there's a newer build than what you're running.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: rare idle-screen flourishes on CLEAR -- UFO flyby, stardust sparkle burst, bird/bat critter flyby, and a glitchy one-liner -- plus a matching fourth-wall wink from Squachy himself, all background-independent
- **Added**: LOCK BACKGROUND setting -- disables CLEAR's accidental tap-to-cycle gestures without touching the Settings screen's own BACKGROUND row
- **Added**: the web flasher now displays the latest deployed firmware version for the selected board
- **Changed**: local/CI builds no longer build the frozen cyd35 environment by default (`pio run` now only builds the three boards that actually ship) -- explicit `pio run -e cyd35` still works when needed
